issues.detail: The Hebrew 'פֶּן תִּכְרֹת בְּרִית לְיוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ' means 'lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land' (i.e., you, Israel, are the subject making the covenant). The Chinese '免得你所要到之地的居民與他們立約' reverses the subject and object, making the inhabitants the ones making a covenant with 'them' (a third party), which changes who is doing what to whom.
